svg.text: Lab account (one account · no TGW · no STNO stack)
Scan + filter · no limit · no nextToken
stops after 1 MB of table read ✗
client loops until nextToken is null ✓
One Scan page = 1 MB of table data,
Not deployed — not needed to reproduce
STNO stacks · TGW · CloudFront + S3 · Cognito · WAF · Step Functions · EventBridge · SNS · Lambda
The write path works in the customer environment; only the read path (AppSync + DynamoDB) is broken.
ground truth: boto3 Scan with ExclusiveStartKey until LastEvaluatedKey is empty
Upstream read: one Scan page, truncates silently
Fix: paginated Scan with limit + nextToken
Alternative: Query on the Status GSI
